basis: carried east of the Potomac shore along the north line so a subtraction clears the shore; placed in the river, not read from a source

Rose 1964, p. 24: the city's boundary runs 'along the Potomac River to one-half square north of First Street'; First Street's modern line is the reference, and half a block, about 45 meters, is added to the north, with the line slanting up to the east as the street grid does
Rose 1964, p. 24: then 'west through one-half a square west of West Street'; West Street's modern line, about 50 meters west of it
Rose 1964, p. 24: then 'south to the north side of Cameron Street', down the same half-square-west line

Rose 1964, p. 24: then 'west to what was the old Francis Peyton lot to Baggott's fence'; placed on the north side of Cameron Street at Peyton Street's modern line, since the lot's own lines are not recoverable

Rose 1964, p. 24: then 'across King Street to the old District line at the crossover of Hough's [Hooff's] run'; placed where the District line meets Duke Street at Hooff's Run, the District line being the straight southwest edge of the modern county outline carried southeast
Rose 1964, p. 24: then 'following the District line to the river'; the same line carried to the diamond's south corner at Jones Point
carried 2 kilometers into the river at right angles to the District line so a subtraction clears the shore; placed in the river, not read from a source
